title: Show HN: Distilling DeepSeek into GPT-OSS doesn't transfer censorship. Try it
summary: A research team distilled DeepSeek V4 Flash into GPT-OSS-120B for finance reasoning tasks, achieving 83.61% on FinanceReasoning benchmark (surpassing Kimi K3 at 81.93%). They released 20B open weights and importantly found that censorship characteristics from the teacher model did not transfer to the distilled student model.
problem_solved: Tests whether content moderation/censorship policies transfer from teacher models to student models during knowledge distillation
why_valuable: Demonstrates that model capabilities can be transferred without inheriting the teacher's content policies, which has significant implications for open-source AI development and model safety research
